Multiple integrations (e.g. HubSpot `packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts`, Lark, Webex, MS Teams adapter) now pass string-literal slugs and `credential.userId` into this wrapper. The diff does not include any test additions/updates to assert those passed values or payload shape, which is a specific risk given the new external-call behavior and reliance on correct slug/userId wiring.
